meta.name: inspired-product
meta.description: Build empowered product teams using discovery and delivery dual-track. Use when the user mentions "product discovery", "empowered teams", "feature factory", "opportunity assessment", "product vision", "product strategy", "what should we build", or "our roadmap is just a feature list". Also trigger when restructuring teams away from output-driven models, or deciding what to build next based on outcomes. Covers discovery techniques, team structure, opportunity assessment, vision/strategy, and continuous delivery. For customer interviews, see mom-test. For ongoing discovery systems, see continuous-discovery.

copy.tagline: 用双轨制打造高绩效产品团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们正从功能工厂转向成果驱动的产品团队
copy.tagline_en: Build empowered product teams with dual-track discovery and delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're shifting from output-driven to outcome-driven product development

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用“发现+交付”双轨方法搭建产品团队，评估团队成熟度，并指导你进行机会评估、愿景/战略制定和持续交付。
howto.when: 当你提到“产品发现”、“赋能团队”、“功能工厂”、“机会评估”、“产品愿景”、“产品策略”、“我们应该构建什么”或“路线图只是功能列表”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我们的团队是功能工厂，怎么转型为赋能团队？
say.note: Claude 会给出诊断和转型步骤。

say.text: 帮我评估这个新功能的机会。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成机会评估。

say.text: 如何制定产品愿景和策略？
say.note: Claude 会提供愿景和策略框架。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build empowered product teams using discovery and delivery dual-track, assess team maturity, and guide you through opportunity assessment, vision/strategy, and continuous delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "product discovery", "empowered teams", "feature factory", "opportunity assessment", "product vision", "product strategy", "what should we build", or "our roadmap is just a feature list".

say_en.text: Our team is a feature factory. How do we transform into an empowered team?
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose and provide transformation steps.

say_en.text: Help me assess this new feature opportunity.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the opportunity assessment.

say_en.text: How do I create a product vision and strategy?
say_en.note: Claude will provide the vision and strategy framework.
